# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository follows repository-wide engineering conventions defined in `AGENTS.md`.

When generating code:

- follow the closest `AGENTS.md`;
- preserve the existing architecture;
- avoid unnecessary abstractions;
- prefer incremental improvements over large rewrites;
- keep generated code production-ready;
- explain non-trivial architectural decisions.

Do not introduce new libraries, frameworks or architectural patterns unless explicitly requested.
